answer: Raven Sentinel Reef Bond: every agent locks 50,000 POA into a reef bond that only matures after 30 days of work, like coral growing on a reef. Step 1: stake the bond and link one hardware identity. Step 2: complete 20 paid tasks; each task releases 5% of the stake. Step 3: peers audit a random 10% of tasks, and a failed audit slashes the whole bond. Step 4: exiting early forfeits 40%. An attacker cloning 1,000 agents must lock 50M POA and fund 20,000 fake tasks, burning $18,000 in fees before earning a cent — a river of clones that dries up at the dam as a raven counts the losses.
